record.question: What does CSIR stand for?
options: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research
Council for Scientific and Industrial Research
Committee of Scientific and Industrial Research
Council of Scientific and Information Research
record.explanation: Answer A: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research. In this Indian MPSC examination, CSIR refers to the Indian national research body; South Africa has a separate CSIR with a different expansion. Reviewed unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
